caption: A flashlight shines through cupped fingers, and the fingers glow red where the light passes through them.

sa.check: The fingers glow red where the light passes through them.

pc.expect: The glow appears where the flesh is thin and would disappear when the flashlight is turned off.
pc.fail: The fingers glow with the light off; or the thick palm glows and the thin fingers do not; or the glow is elsewhere.
It is white or blue; or it changes colour with a steady light; or the fingers change colour when the light is off.

pc.expect: The light beyond the hand is dim compared with the glow.
pc.fail: The room beyond is fully lit; or the beam passes through the hand unhindered; or the wall behind is brighter than the fingers.

pc.expect: The hand and flashlight move only as the person moves them.
pc.fail: They float; or the flashlight moves by itself; or the glow moves with both still.
A second hand appears; or a finger vanishes; or the hand passes through the lens.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.
The walls change; or the flashlight changes; or the room rearranges.

note: The hand is the object the light passes through; the person is not judged.
